headline: Corn Prices Drop to Three-Month Low on US Harvest and Brazilian Real
summary: Corn hit its lowest close in three months as a large US harvest, fund selling, and a weaker Brazilian real outweighed continued buying from China.
why: Agricultural commodity prices are heavily influenced by supply levels, crop harvest volumes, and foreign exchange rates that affect international export competitiveness.

impacts.name: Corn
impacts.why: The input states that corn hit its lowest close in three months.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A combination of a large US harvest, speculative fund selling, and a weaker Brazilian real increased supply pressures and pushed prices down.
